author: tahoebio
description:
✨ (New!) Access Tahoe-100M directly from your coding agents using the Tara plugin
	

The Tara plugin is the new agent-native route for exploring Tahoe datasets including Tahoe-100M. It incorporates scientific guidance that familiarizes your agents with our data, 
and can perform querries on Tahoe-100M scale data within seconds. Install it in your preferred coding agents (claude, codex, grok etc) and incorporate Tahoe-100M in your scientific analyses seamlessly.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tahoebio/Tahoe-100M.
